comments.snippet:
This report came from 1.84.0 (Release 3716), the stable release of 2026-09-25. Its stack, `ComboBox.OnFontChanged` during `WmDpiChangedBeforeParent`, is the one tracked in #209, and the window it names is the same: the Quick Connect box, at 51 USER objects, so not a handle quota problem.

Commit 745a32bc3 (2026-10-07) is in the current nightly, not in 1.84.0. After a DPI change it gives the Quick Connect box its window back, and the crash report now carries the `Win32 error:` code that says why ...

notes: same stack as #209/#218 from 1.84.0 stable 3716; 745a32bc3 in nightly; close as fixed with #209
